messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: billing_ingest_eu1 queue latency > 120s for 00:08. Token aggregation delayed, some overage flags emitted to customers. Pager triggered for oncall.

maria: seeing same in dashboards. token_ingest lag spike at ~6573214200, backlog on partition-3.

jack: @maria can you paste the consumer group lag? I can take the oncall bridge if needed.

maria: consumer_lag: partition-3 = 1.2M, partition-4 = 200k. ETA for catching up unclear.

amanda: we got 6 customer overage alerts in the last 10m, volume small but noisy. Customer SNs in #support thread.

chris: looking at emitter logs — saw repeated retries from proxy-emitter v2.4.3, error 429 then fallback -> duplicate ack path. snippet: ```WARN emitter: retrying push, 429 from billing-proxy (x5)
WARN dedupe: missing epk header for some batches```

jack: ok suspects: emitter retries + consumer slowdown on eu1. Can we pause retries or route to fallback region?

maria: can toggle emitter throttling flag. /runops feature_flag set emitter_retry_limit=3 for eu1?
jack: do it. also opening temporary routing to eu2 for overflow: `route-billing --from eu1 --to eu2 --threshold 100k`

incident-bot: ACTION CREATED: #INC-2026 emergency-routing, assigned to jack.

amanda: alerting affected customers that we're investigating billing delays; noting potential false overages. DMing CS to hold off billing emails. :warning:

chris: throttling flag applied. emitter retry spikes dropped from 1200/min -> 220/min. Consumer lag still draining slowly but steady.

maria: consumer group rebalanced at 6573214520, throughput up ~30%. backlog now partition-3 = 400k.

jack: can we kick a manual backfill consumer to speed catch-up? I can deploy a short-lived job: `kafka-consume --group tmp-backfill --limit 600000`

amanda: CS created a customer-impact note in ops-docs and paused auto-invoices for impacted accounts.

sre-oncall: taking over bridge for next 30m. jack, leave route in place and leave backfill job running; I'll watch metrics and coordinate rollback if duplicates increase.

maria: recording timeline in the incident doc. root cause still under investigation (proxy-emitter 429 surge -> retries -> consumer overload).

jack: next steps: (1) let backfill run, (2) monitor duplicate token metric, (3) prepare a small reconciliation job to reconcile late tokens into billing ledger after catch-up.

amanda: opened ticket ENG-8421 for reconciliation and customer refunds process if overcharges confirmed.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: status=investigating -> mitigation_in_progress. participants updated.

sre-oncall: handoff note: I'll stay until backlog <50k and duplicate-rate <0.1%. switching to oncall alias `sre-night` now. :thumbsup:
